hero.titleLine2: One scoreboard for the whole squad.
hero.subtitle: Create a private Space, invite your friends, and turn your FIFA nights into a real league — standings, tournaments, weekly challenges, and scouting reports included.
hero.note: Free for you and one friend. No card required.

features.heading: Built for the whole group chat
features.subtitle: Everything the old spreadsheet argument needed — generalized from two players to your whole crew.

items.title: Head-to-head comparison
items.body: Pick any two members of your Space and get an instant rivalry breakdown — stat totals, best single week, tie-broken W/D/L, all-time bragging rights.

items.title: Group-wide standings
items.body: Every member ranked on a single weighted P-Index, computed from an all-play-all round robin each week — fair at 2 members, and just as fair at 10.

items.title: Tournaments with real prizes
items.body: Monthly, yearly, or one-off custom tournaments hand out a Golden Boot, Golden Vision, Golden Skills, Tournament Winner, and Player of the Month — with genuine multi-way ties when the numbers say so.

items.title: Weekly challenges
items.body: A fresh challenge drawn from hundreds of stat-driven prompts each week, worth easy/medium/hard bonus points on top of your normal totals.

items.title: Man of the Match, automatically
items.body: The moment a week is logged, statsDor scores every performance and crowns the standout — with the runner-up comparison to back it up.

items.title: Scouting reports & tiers
items.body: Every member gets a living scouting report: form, tier, and a market value that rises and falls with their recent performances.

items.title: Configurable stat attributes
items.body: Goals, assists, dribbles, and more come enabled by default — toggle any of them off, or add your own, per Space, any time from Settings.

finalCta.title: Ready to settle the rivalry?
finalCta.body: Create your Space in under a minute. Invite a friend, log your first week, and let the numbers do the talking.

pricing.title: Simple, seat-based pricing
pricing.subtitle: Every feature is available on every plan. Free covers a head-to-head rivalry of two — Pro just adds room for the rest of the group.

pro.title: Pro
pro.priceNote: billed once per upgrade, no subscription
features: Extra seats for your whole crew
Same Space, same history — just more members
pro.cta: Sign up, then upgrade from Settings

pricing.footnotePost: and upgrade any time from Settings → Billing — seats are added instantly, no waiting on a sales call.
